epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

**Ruling recorded: option A.** The maintainer, verbatim, in the direct session on 2026-11-04: 「同意 A」

The platform baseline `member_default` grants `sys_comment` (read, create, edit) and `sys_activity` (read). The parent-record gates decide which rows.

The dev verifies these before landing, as the card's risk paragraph says:

- The parent gates hold for an external member, because `member_default` also reaches `everyone`.
- An object with `enable.feeds: false` still refuses on both verbs.
- The grant does not bring back the per-object refusal log noise #23279 measured.

If one of these fails, report a fork. Do not narrow the grant silently and do not fall back to option B.

Left for triage to route. No lane or claim is set here.

## Triage: first-touch audit · p1 · `domain:server` · `pm:queue` · 2026-11-04T14:52Z

⛔ Not a claim.

- Read fresh. Ruled A (6633054352, 「同意 A」): the platform baseline `member_default` grants `sys_comment` (read, create, edit) and `sys_activity` (read), with access still derived from the parent record. Today every non-admin member of a new app sees "no permission" on comments and activity, on default-on features. p1.
- Fix site: `plugin-security`'s `default-permission-sets.ts`, so `domain:server`. It widens a default grant, a permission boundary, so the PR measures that a reader still sees only the comments and activity of records they may read, and it goes through contract review.
